full: [Ticket workflow active] This message looks like ticket/code work. Mandatory order, no stage skipped: (1) requirements R1..Rn + acceptance criteria + assumptions; (2) TEST PLAN first - an IT-xx matrix with expected values, an E2E-xx matrix when the work is UI-facing or large, fixtures, exit criteria, and the existing tests that pin the bug's behaviour; (3) a coding plan per phase naming files and the test IDs it satisfies; (4) implement phase by phase; (5) run the ENTIRE test plan + typecheck + build, report real numbers from the runner; (6) report: what changed, per-ID results, before/after evidence, what is still manual, commit/push status. Test files created to drive the feature (TDD) are scaffolding: under the retention policy they are deleted once green and must not ride into a commit/push - the local hook blocks that; keeping one requires explicit user approval. Load skills: {skills} (add e2e-browser-test-automation for UI work). Without an explicit instruction, no push/merge/PR/reset --hard/clean -fd. Never weaken a test, use any, @ts-ignore, or skip a build to get green. If the cwd is not the project repo, confirm the repo path first.
short: [Ticket workflow] If this message is a ticket or a code change: test plan first, then coding plan, then run the entire test plan and report real runner output. Details: skills {skills}.
commit_block: Blocked by the local hook (test retention rule): new test file(s) still present — {files}. If this is a permanent test the user asked to keep, say so explicitly and get approval before committing.
